messages:
Priya K.: Heads up — starting a config-only canary now for sparse routing thresholds + batching params. No model or code changes. Pinning config: cfg-v2.21-sparse. Change window 12:00-13:00 PT. Observability: smoke tests + synthetic prompt set. deploy-bot will kick things off.

deploy-bot: Canary started for cfg-v2.21-sparse on 5% traffic (region: us-west). Report: https://deploy/reports/6845123000

Jorge M.: Quick question — what are our rollback criteria for this one? Latency or error rate thresholds?

Priya K.: Rollback criteria: 95th latency > 350ms sustained over 5m OR absolute error-rate increase >= 0.5% vs baseline OR KV-cache hit rate drop > 4 percentage points. Also flag if p99 > 1s. Manual rollback command: `/rollout rollback cfg-v2.20-stable`

Sasha L.: Can we run the synthetic prompt set against the canary before ramping traffic? Want to catch any quality regressions from routing/batching changes.

Priya K.: Yes — launching synthetics now. Command we used: ```
./scripts/synthetics/run --set=canary-thin -r us-west --concurrency=4
``` Will post results in ~10m.

Devon: Added a temporary panel to the routing dashboard: `canary-sparse` and a short lived alert `canary-latency-guard`. Dash: https://grafana.company/routing?panel=canary-sparse

deploy-bot: Synthetic run complete — 1000 prompts. median=120ms, p95=290ms, errors=0.20% (baseline 0.15%). Not hitting rollback thresholds but slight uptick in errors.

Jorge M.: Errors are up a touch. Recommend hold at 5% for 30m and re-evaluate before any ramp.

Priya K.: Agreed. Holding at 5% for 30m. If stable we'll ramp to 20% at ~12:40PT. @SRE please watch traces for cold-starts due to batch-window shortening.

Sasha L.: :thumbsup: I'll watch traces and notify if any unusual tail latency or error clusters appear.

Priya K.: Note — per-tenant limit for test tenants (A,C) lowered 200 -> 180 tokens/sec for the canary. This is reversible via the rollback command above.

deploy-bot: Next scheduled action: ramp to 20% in 00:17:50 unless someone halts the rollout. Use `/rollout halt` to abort.

Devon: Ran quick smoke throughput test for tenant C against canary config — no increase in tail latency, throughput steady.

Priya K.: Thanks all. I'll post a short release note after the ramp completes with links to the deploy report and synthetic results. If anyone sees something bad, say `halt` in this thread and deploy-bot will pause.

Jorge M.: Sounds good, watching.
